---
title: "ST Player Comparison Prototype"
format: html
resources:
  - data/player_st_comparison_features.json
  - player-st.js
---

This is a static prototype for interactive ST player comparison, radar selection, and a similarity preview.

::: {.html}
<div id="dataStatus">Loading data...</div>
<div id="dataDebug"></div>

<div id="controls">
  <h2>Filters</h2>
  <div>
    <label for="seasonSelect">Season</label>
    <select id="seasonSelect"></select>
  </div>
  <div>
    <label for="minutesInput">Minimum minutes</label>
    <input id="minutesInput" type="number" min="0" step="50" value="1200">
  </div>
  <div>
    <label for="playerSelect">Players (multi-select)</label>
    <select id="playerSelect" multiple size="8"></select>
  </div>
  <div>
    <label for="metricSelect">Metrics (multi-select)</label>
    <select id="metricSelect" multiple size="8"></select>
  </div>
  <div>
    <label for="radarModeSelect">Radar value mode</label>
    <select id="radarModeSelect">
      <option value="z" selected>Z-scores</option>
      <option value="raw">Raw values</option>
    </select>
  </div>
</div>

<h2>Radar Comparison</h2>
<div id="radar"></div>
<div id="radarStatus"></div>

<h2>Similarity</h2>
<p>Similarity uses Euclidean distance across ST z-score features within the filtered dataset.</p>
<div>
  <label for="targetSelect">Target player</label>
  <select id="targetSelect"></select>
</div>
<div id="similarityStatus"></div>
<table id="similarityTable">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Player</th>
      <th>Season</th>
      <th>Team</th>
      <th>Minutes</th>
      <th>Distance</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody></tbody>
</table>

<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.27.0.min.js"></script>
<script src="player-st.js"></script>
:::
